\par\vspace{2pt}
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize
Countries are ordered by \textit{Pf}PR$_{2-10}$ (national MAP estimate, population-weighted), highest first. Rates are deaths per 1,000 child-years (cy) under 5, with each source's child-years: the UN WPP population under 5 for UN IGME, IHME-implied person-years for IHME; percentages in brackets are shares of all under-five deaths. PfPR-ACM: deaths attributable to malaria (prevalence reduced to zero) from the seven age-band models applied to the source's all-cause deaths by age, crisis years replaced by crisis-free values. Malaria mortality models: IHME malaria deaths, as a share of IHME all-cause deaths; UN IGME (CA-CODE) malaria deaths, with CA-CODE's published share. $^{*}$Crisis year in IHME: crisis-free value shown (reported South Sudan 29.4). $^{\dagger}$CA-CODE takes malaria from WHO estimates in this country. Last row: population-weighted average (\textit{Pf}PR$_{2-10}$ weighted by the WPP population under 5; rates as total deaths over total child-years). Point estimates only.
\end{minipage}
